I'm excited to share a unique PhD opportunity at TU Delft's Industrial Design Engineering that sits at the intersection of design, technology, and healthcare impact.

The Challenge: Neonatal and Paediatric ICUs are among the noisiest healthcare environments. Constant alarms, equipment sounds, and conversations don't just disturb—they harm infant development and contribute to nurse alarm fatigue and burnout.

Your Mission: Design an NPICU Data Commons—a groundbreaking digital platform that empowers nurses to understand and actively shape their acoustic environment. This isn't about creating another monitoring dashboard. It's about putting nurses in the driver's seat as investigators and designers of their own workplace.

What We're Looking For: ✓ MSc in HCI, Industrial Design Engineering, or related fields ✓ Passion for human-centered design and qualitative research ✓ Experience with data visualization and prototyping ✓ Programming skills and ML background ✓ Fluency in English and Dutch ✓ Genuine interest in creating healthcare solutions that matter

📍 Location: TU Delft | Industrial Design Engineering, Netherlands

⏰ Application deadline: Feb 28, 2026
